title: Craftmaster Tieranu
summary: Control Tieranu's summoned elementals and deny the final healing sacrifices.
overview: A ranger at the required epic stage triggers Tieranu by entering the zone while the two-hour event cooldown is clear.
Tieranu summons Flamegore at 70%, Sizzle at 45% and Hotspot at 20%. Hotspot splits into five small elementals when killed.
At each 10% health crossing, Tieranu can sacrifice one remaining small elemental and recover 10% of maximum health. Clear those elementals before the final push.

phases.label: Sizzle
phases.description: Control the second elemental alongside any survivors.

phases.label: Hotspot and fragments
phases.description: Prepare for five small elementals when Hotspot dies.

phases.label: Deny the healing loop
phases.description: Remove the small elementals so Tieranu cannot consume one to recover health.

abilities.name: Elemental spells
abilities.summary: Elementals strip buffs and cast Heatwave at their current target.
description: The buff-stripping action repeats every ten seconds after its initial random delay. Heatwave repeats every twenty seconds after its initial delay.

sections.title: Recovery
paragraphs: Tieranu initially remains for thirty minutes. Combat pauses that timer; leaving combat starts a five-minute cleanup timer.
